pdf.title: Exercise answer report
pdf.subject: Exercise statistics and latest attributed answers
pdf.definitions: Released completion counts team/individual and inject pairs that are currently published. Information updates are excluded. N/A means no response injects are released. Completion requires every question part, including optional questions, or an acknowledgement for a question-free inject. It does not score answer quality. Retained completed injects counts injects completed by at least one team or person, including work that is now unpublished.
pdf.attribution_help: Roster counts use current assignments. Saved replies keep the team recorded at submission. The named author identifies who entered a reply, without implying that it is their personal opinion. Choice and numeric summaries count saved entries, not group votes. Only the latest revision of each reply is shown. Full revision history and original evidence files are in the ZIP export.
pdf.no_teams: No teams or individual participants are assigned.
